meta.name: init-first-agent
meta.description: Walk the operator through creating the first NanoClaw agent for a DM channel — resolve the operator's channel identity, wire the DM messaging group to a new agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

copy.tagline: 引导创建首个智能体并配置消息通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速搭建并测试第一个智能体机器人。
copy.tagline_en: Guide through creating the first agent and configuring messaging channels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly set up and test your first agent bot.

howto.what: 这个流程会一步步带你创建第一个 NanoClaw 代理:先让你选一个聊天频道,再问你的用户 ID、显示名和代理名,然后建立代理,并让代理给你发一条欢迎私信。
howto.when: 在频道凭据已配置、服务运行中,并且你要求初始化第一个代理时触发。

say.note: Claude 会先询问要使用哪个频道。

say.text: 帮我创建第一个 NanoClaw 代理并验证私信
say.note: 它会收集你的身份信息并发送欢迎私信。

say.text: 开始设置我的第一个频道代理
say.note: 流程会问你用户 ID、显示名和代理名。

howto.what_en: Walks the operator through creating the first NanoClaw agent for a DM channel: pick the channel, provide user ID/display name/agent name, then the agent is created and sends a welcome DM to the operator.
howto.when_en: Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running, when the operator asks to initialize the first agent.

say_en.note: Claude asks which channel to use.

say_en.text: Create my first NanoClaw agent and verify the DM.
say_en.note: It collects your identity and sends a welcome DM.

say_en.text: Set up my first channel agent.
say_en.note: It asks for user ID, display name and agent name.
